name: study-partners
description: Finding someone to study with, in person or online.

languages.description: Languages it is offered in, as BCP 47 tags such as en or es.

howDealsGo: Two people agree a time, a place or a call, and a subject, and study. Done is the session held; then each reviews the other. Usually no money changes hands, so there is no escrow and no receipt: showing up is what builds a record here. Before meeting, agree what you'll each prepare.
